research.name: Adventurers Guild Level 2
research.description: 25% shorter spawn intervals, +20 adventurer capacity, and party formation reduced from 20 to 15 real seconds.

research.name: Basic Adventurers Guild
research.description: A recruitment stand that prioritizes missing party roles among eligible, unpartied adventurers.

research.name: Get diggin'
research.description: The first five dungeon floors are unlocked.

research.name: Better basic traps
research.description: Medium · Mimics II resemble silver chests and deal 10–20 damage. Trap doors deal 10–20 damage and require perception 20.

research.name: Beginner trap stealth
research.description: Fast · Increase beginner trap detection difficulty by 1, up to 10. Advanced trap doors retain perception 20.

research.name: Getting serious are we?
research.description: Large · Unlock the next five floors. Repeat to reach 50 floors.

research.name: Fleet-footed staff
research.description: Medium · Double staff movement speed and speed up maintenance work. Trap resets use staff speed plus intelligence against trap difficulty.

research.name: Better stamina management
research.description: Fast · Choose the stamina threshold at which staff take their next office break.

research.name: Level 2 adventurers
research.description: Medium · Upgrade individual town spawn points to attract adventurers with double baseline stats and elaborate class outfits.

research.name: Gold chests
research.description: Medium · Unlock gold chests. Silver has twice the wood stats; gold doubles silver again.

research.name: Local ads
research.description: Unlock two extra adventurer spawn points. Each costs 25 gold and adds 10 to the adventurer population cap.

research.name: It's a trap!
research.description: Trap doors, arrow walls, and suspiciously toothy chests.

research.name: Mob-tastic
research.description: Invite zombies and slimes to make themselves at home.

research.name: Treasure-me-timbers
research.description: Wood and silver chests. A little incentive goes a long way.

research.name: Basic rest spots
research.description: Bunks, a tap, and a much-needed stamina refill.

research.name: Basic door policy
research.description: Level-one adventurers only. Set your entrance fee.

research.name: Sketchy finances
research.description: Decide how much admission income goes back into treasure.

research.name: Staff management
research.description: Hire maintenance workers and keep an eye on your crew.

research.name: Short-sighted training
research.description: +1 to all stats. Including the XP requirement. How convenient.

research.name: Faster digging
research.description: Bigger shovels. Twice the excavation speed.

research.name: Better building
research.description: Reinforced foundations: 20 health and defense. Builders upgrade furnished floors from deepest to shallowest. Novice builders take twice as long.
